character_sheet: MARCUS: a business owner in his late 30s. Short dark beard, neat. Charcoal suit jacket worn over an open-collar shirt, no tie. Athletic build, mid-height. Rendered as a clean semi-realistic 3D-lit figure with slightly exaggerated proportions for comic readability. He is EVERY image's same person: identical face, beard, jacket and rendering. He is an everyman business owner, never a celebrity, never a real identifiable individual.

images.concept: Standing, both hands gripping the sides of his head, elbows flared out, face screwed up in overwhelmed frustration. Mouth open in a groan. Shoulders hunched up toward his ears.
Turning in place looking around, one hand shading his eyes like a lookout, the other holding a crumpled useless map at his side. Expression: completely lost but still searching.
Leaning forward with both palms pressed flat against an invisible vertical wall, straining hard, feet braced behind him. Face tight with effort. The wall itself is not drawn.
Standing upright, head tilted slightly back, eyebrows raised high, one index finger lifted in the air. The exact half-second of realisation. Mouth slightly open.
Standing with arms folded, weight on one leg, chin lifted, looking directly forward with calm resolve. Settled and decided, not aggressive.
Both fists raised and clenched at shoulder height, head thrown back, mouth wide open in a triumphant shout. Full-body celebration.

A flowchart of boxes connected by arrows where the flow breaks: several boxes float disconnected off to the sides with arrows that loop back on themselves in a dead circle, while one clean straight path runs through the middle unused. The loop is drawn in burnt orange, the unused straight path in teal.

An overhead view of dense jungle canopy with a single tiny clearing. No visible path. One small figure-sized dot in the middle of the canopy with no route drawn to or from it. Vast, disorienting, no orientation cues.

The same scattered boxes now organised into one clean left-to-right sequence with numbered steps and single arrows between them. Two side branches are crossed out with a marker X. A thick teal line traces the one path that runs all the way through.

Split composition. Left: a rigid rectangular template being forced down over an irregular organic shape, edges crushed and overhanging, drawn in burnt orange. Right: a flexible outline traced precisely around that same irregular shape, fitting exactly, drawn in teal.

Four labelled boxes in a descending diagonal chain, each with an arrow pointing back up to the one above it, so responsibility passes upward in a chain that never terminates. The final arrow at the top curves off the edge of the frame pointing at nothing.

Split composition. Left: a narrow funnel with a single tiny opening, everything else walled off, drawn in burnt orange. Right: a wide open fan of many clearly-lit parallel routes spreading outward, all visible at once, drawn in teal and gold.

A line graph descending steeply from upper left to lower right, drawn as a cracking fault line rather than a smooth curve, with the ground beneath it fracturing into pieces. Restrained, editorial, no figures.

A single vantage point where two paths diverge. One is a faint worn loop that curves back to where it started. The other is a straight lit road running to a clear horizon. Seen from behind and above, no figure.

A technical blueprint of a multi-stage funnel drawn as connected chambers, with one single chamber circled and called out with a leader line and a small label box. Every other chamber is drawn in thin neutral line; only the circled one is emphasised.
